top_signals.title: Why Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia Matters for China
top_signals.summary:
After a week of whiplash over Jensen Huang’s future and new US chip curbs, Beijing sent a clear message to Washington about their trade truce: China is holding up its side of the bargain — for now.

Nectar Gan explains why China may be playing the long game. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: The Contract Was the Easy Part: How Accelerator Day Put the Pentagon on the Clock
